paite: Paula, Pathian deihlama Kris Jesu sawltakin, misiangthou Ephesa khuaa om Kris Jesu-a mi ginomte kiangah:
english: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, to the saints who are at Ephesus, and the faithful in Christ Jesus:

paite: Pathian i Pa leh Toupa Jesu Kris kianga kipan hehpihna leh lemna na kiang uah om hen.
english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

paite: I Toupa Jesu Kris Pa leh Pathian phatin om hen. Aman vanmun khawnga khalam vualjawlna chitengin eite kris ah honvualjawlta,
english: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places in Christ;

paite: Amah maia siangthou leh dembeia om dinga leitung pian maa eite honnateltak bang ngeiin.
english: even as he chose us in him before the foundation of the world, that we would be holy and without blemish before him in love;

paite: Aman a deiha a tup bangbangin, eite Jesu Kris vanga a tate hi dingin, itna jiakin honnasepkhol khinta,
english: having predestined us for adoption as children through Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his desire,

paite: Huchi-a It-a a honpiak hondeihsakna thupi mahmah pahtawina i hih theihna dingin.
english: to the praise of the glory of his grace, by which he freely bestowed favor on us in the Beloved,

paite: A sisan jiakin Amah ah tatkhiakna, huai a hehpihna hauhdan bangbanga i tatleknate ngaihdamna ngei i tangta hi,
english: in whom we have our redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of his grace,

paite: Tua hehpihna tuh chillou hialin aman eite a honpeta.
english: which he made to abound toward us in all wisdom and prudence,

paite: A thiltup, Kris-a a gelkhiak, bangbangin a deihlam thuguk tuh pilna leh theihsiamna ngenin eite hontheisakta ngala;
english: making known to us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he purposed in him

paite: Huai a deihlam thilgel bel; hunbi hongkim chianga, thil tengteng-vana omte leh leitunga omte-Kris-a gawmkhawma a suktuah vek ding tuh ahi.
english: to an administration of the fullness of the times, to sum up all things in Christ, the things in the heavens, and the things on the earth, in him;

paite: Amah deihlam, a lunggel bangbanga thilbangkim semkhepa tup bang ngeiin, amah mah-ah
english: in whom also we were assigned an inheritance, having been foreordained according to the purpose of him who works all things after the counsel of his will;

paite: Koute, Kris-a ana lamen masate, a thupina pahtawina dinga hing dingin sehkholhin kana omkhinta uhi.
english: to the end that we should be to the praise of his glory, we who had before hoped in Christ:

paite: Huan, noute, thutak thu, na hotdamna tanchinhoih uh ngaikhiaa gin leng gingtate leng, amah ah chiamsa Kha Siangthou-a chiamtehin na om uhi;
english: in whom you also, having heard the word of the truth, the Good News of your salvation—in whom, having also believed, you were sealed with the Holy Spirit of promise,

paite: Huai Kha Siangthou bel i gouluah ding tatna kim i luah matenga, Pathian thupina dinga, khamna ahi.
english: who is a pledge of our inheritance, to the redemption of God’s own possession, to the praise of his glory.

paite: Huaijiakin ken leng Toupa Jesua ginna na lak ua om, misiangthoute tengteng tunga na kitheihsak jel uh ka najakin,
english: For this cause I also, having heard of the faith in the Lord Jesus which is among you, and the love which you have toward all the saints,

paite: Ka thumnate ah na min uh lou-in nou jiaka kipahthu gen ka tawp kei hi;
english: don’t cease to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers,

paite: I Toupa Jesu Kris Pathian, thupina Pan Amah theihna lam thu-a pilna leh kilakna kha nou a honpiak theihna dingin,
english: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give to you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him;

paite: Huchia, na lungsim mitte uh hihvaka hongoma, na theihna ding un-huaibel, Aman nou a honsapna lametna bang; misianthoute-a a gouluah hauhsaknate bang;
english: having the eyes of your hearts TR reads “understanding” instead of “hearts” enlightened, that you may know what is the hope of his calling, and what are the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,

paite: Huan, a gingta eite-a A thilhihtheihna thupina tehvuallouh, huai A hatna thupi sep bang jela,
english: and what is the exceeding greatness of his power toward us who believe, according to that working of the strength of his might

paite: Kris-a a sepzohtak, huchia amah misi lak akipana a kaihthoha, vanmun khawnga A taklama a tutsaka,
english: which he worked in Christ, when he raised him from the dead, and made him to sit at his right hand in the heavenly places,

paite: Lalnate, thuneihnate, thilhihtheihnate, vaihawmna tengteng tung leh tu khovel kia hilou-a khovel hongtung ding nangawna minsak chiteng tung tham peka a koih laia a sepzoh chih bang.
english: far above all rule, and authority, and power, and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this age, but also in that which is to come.

paite: Huan Aman bangkim a khe nuai ah a koiha, amah tuh bangkim tengteng tunga Suptuam lutangin a bawl,Huai saptuam tuh a pumpi a hi-a, amah bang kima bangkim hihdimpa tangchinna ngei.
english: He put all things in subjection under his feet, and gave him to be head over all things for the assembly,

paite: Huai saptuam tuh a pumpi a hi-a, amah bang kima bangkim hihdimpa tangchinna ngei.
english: which is his body, the fullness of him who fills all in all.
